title: Derived native open projection comparison
statement: For a native open tensor datum s, nativeOpenDerivedLeft is naturally isomorphic to nativeOpenDerivedRight: tensoring the extension by zero of the first input with the second input agrees with extension by zero of the tensor with the restriction of the second input.

proof.text: Use the acyclic-test K-flat resolving subcategories on the open and ambient schemes. Convert their tests to NativeIsKFlat and apply the extension and restriction preservation fields of s.

Apply the natural tensor models to the extended first complex and ambient second complex, and to the first complex and restricted second complex. Insert the cochain projection comparison and exact derived-functor factorizations.
Fully faithful whiskering along the product of the two K-flat localizations descends the assembled isomorphism to all derived inputs.
